headline: Pay rate ordinances for Locals 251 and 3960, an easement at 100 Freight Street, Narragansett Park Plaza code violations, and damage claims.
summary: The agenda covers pay rate ordinances for Local 251 and Local 3960. It also includes an electric utility pole easement at 100 Freight Street, a response on code violations at Narragansett Park Plaza, and several damage claims against the city.
items: Audit Report for Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2025, prepared by CliftonLarsonAllen LLP
2026 Biannual Report from the Pawtucket Commission on Arts and Culture
Statement of estimated, realized and unrealized revenues for July 1, 2026, through August 31, 2026
Communication on Smithfield Avenue roadwork from Councilor Marlena Martins Stachowiak
Communication on Moshassuck Industrial Highway from Councilor Marlena Martins Stachowiak
Application for the FY 2026 Edward Byrne Memorial Justice Assistance Grant Program
Response on Narragansett Park Plaza property inspection and code violations
Easement for Rhode Island Energy to install an electric utility pole at 100 Freight Street, referred to the City Property Committee
Claim by Pericles Vieira for $1,349.08 (tire), referred to the Committee on Claims and Pending Suits
Claims by Jose A. Lopes ($5,800.00), Lynn Farinelli ($2,347,000.00+), and Lynn Farinelli and Cristina Bento ($666,666.66), referred to the Law Department and RI Interlocal Trust
Rhode Island Energy petition for installation at Freight Street, pending approval from the Director of Public Works
Confirm reappointment of Patricia Martinez to the Personnel Board
Confirm reappointment of Jane Larson to the Advisory Commission on Arts and Culture
Confirm reappointment of Elizabeth Crowley to the Planning Commission
Confirm reappointment of Nancy T. Pelletier to the Purchasing Board
Confirm reappointment of James Bradford to the Water Supply Board
Confirm reappointment of Paula A. McAloon to the Zoning Board of Appeals
Confirm reappointment of Maribel Echeverry McLaughlin, Esq. to the Juvenile Hearing Board
Confirm reappointment of Marilee E. Arsenault as alternate Democratic member of the Board of Canvassers
Ordinance repealing and replacing pay rates for Local 251 in Section 88-12 of the city code (Teamsters 2026-2029), for second passage

Ordinance repealing and replacing pay rates for Local 3960 in Section 88-12 of the city code (add Parking Enforcement Officer), returned by the Finance Committee with a recommendation for approval, for first passage

Claims returned by the Committee on Claims and Pending Suits: Carrie Cardoso ($350.14, tire); Courtney Petter ($623.12, manhole); Ryan Boudreau ($374.71, manhole); Timothy Pacheco III ($1,717.78, vehicle damage); Karen Zapata ($1,172.50 / $2,029.80, property damage); Sherry Marshall ($266.19, tire); Cody Tavares by Progressive Subrogation ($1,301.83, fire vehicle); Antonia Ramos and Gerson Dos Santos ($2,100.00, vehicle damage)
location: Pawtucket Municipal Annex, First Floor City Council Chambers, 100 Freight Street
